name: Dried macadamia
summary: Dried macadamia. The tourism portal says the farms skip herbicide, chemical pesticide, and heavy inorganic fertilizer. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, page titled Mắc ca sấy. The 2024 handbook has a matching nut note under hạt macca.
taste: The tourism portal praises the aroma and the taste and does not name a roast, a salt, or a flavor beyond that.
howToEat: The tourism portal says growers use a traditional method: no herbicide, no chemical pesticide, and no heavy use of inorganic fertilizer. Eat the dried nut or carry it home.
The same portal says more than 1,000 hectares of macadamia grow at Quảng Trực in Tuy Đức. A bag price is Check on arrival.
where: Quảng Trực, Tuy Đức, for the orchard belt. A shop in Gia Nghia was not named. Hours are Check on arrival.
